verdict.rationale: Vue's docs explicitly market it as 'incrementally adoptable' scaling from a library to full framework, and community testimonials confirm it can be dropped into existing pages/apps by 'selectively adding it here and there in the templates' or via a simple script include ('download vue(.min).js and you are ready to go'), matching the story's no-rewrite integration use case. missing for 10: no dedicated first-party tutorial/guide item specifically titled for progressive/CDN-based enhancement of existing HTML in this pack, and no independent hands-on report beyond forum anecdotes.
